title: Kidney Health Care Guidance
source: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for Chronic Kidney Disease
reviewed_by: Dr. S. Nair, DM (Nephrology Review Board)

doctor_tests: Annual serum creatinine (eGFR) and urine ACR if diabetic or hypertensive
food: Adequate hydration and balanced sodium intake
low.hospital_guidance: Primary care clinic or diagnostic lab.

doctor_tests: Nephrologist or Physician review within 2–4 weeks
Repeat eGFR, Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio (ACR), and Renal Ultrasound
exercise: Moderate regular exercise as tolerated; avoid dehydration
food: Limit excess dietary salt and avoid unprescribed over-the-counter painkillers/herbal supplements
moderate.hospital_guidance: Hospital with Nephrology OPD and accredited biochemistry lab.

doctor_tests: Comprehensive Renal Panel, Electrolytes, Urine ACR, Renal Ultrasound, and BP monitoring
exercise: Light supervised activity only after Nephrologist clearance
food: Renal dietitian guidance on sodium, potassium, phosphorus, and protein targets
high.hospital_guidance: Tertiary hospital with Nephrology, Dialysis, and Critical Care.
